selection_policy: Curated, popularity-weighted coverage of 60 distinct model identities, not an asserted exact global ranking. Prefer recent active models with dated first-party or transparent platform usage signals; treat open-weight downloads and repository engagement as scoped proxies; keep unavailable adoption explicitly unknown. Resolve aliases, endpoints, quantizations, and same-weight variants to one underlying identity; preserve a deliberate specialist reserve for typed semantic and tabular decision models, including Jev. Select across language, reasoning, code, multimodal understanding, open-weight, and decision categories for capability breadth without treating release novelty or benchmarks as popularity. Platform counters cover only their stated scope, and unlike tokens, downloads, and stars are not numerically compared.
